about: St. John’s is the capital of Newfoundland and Labrador, on the Avalon Peninsula of the island of Newfoundland. It is one of the oldest European-founded cities in North America, built around a steep-sided Atlantic harbour. Brightly painted row houses, a compact downtown, and nearby headlands define the city. About 110,000 people live in St. John’s.
seoSummary: Newfoundland and Labrador’s capital, a historic Atlantic harbour city on the Avalon Peninsula.
